fullText.simplified:
九、就是现在

    小白咬住大雕的翅膀，向洞口走去。
    “放开我！”大雕疼得大叫，他生气极了，想要飞起来，但小白没有给他机会。大雕越来越疼，也越来越害怕。两年前被小白咬住的那一次，他都没有这么害怕。
    小白大叫一声，大雕听不清他叫了什么，但是石头后面的饭饭听清了——“小猫！快！就是现在！”
    饭饭马上跑出来，把手里的石头飞了出去！石头打在了大雕的头和眼睛上！
    “啊！”大雕疼得快哭了。他的翅膀和头都有些红色的东西，他知道那是什么，但他的眼睛太疼了，他看不清。
    “谁……是谁打我？”
    “疼！太疼了！”
    “放开我……”
    “我的眼睛……怎么……怎么看不见了……”
    “小白……放开……我……”
    “……”
    大雕的声音越来越小，后来，他叫不出来了，也不动了。
    小白跑到洞外，努力爬上一块大石头。他站在高高的石头上，放开了大雕。
    大雕的翅膀动了动，但他飞不起来了。他的身体像是一块石头，从山上直直地掉了下去。一声，两声，三声……小白和饭饭听得到他的身体掉在下面石头上的声音。
    听着这些声音，小白坐到了地上，他的腿和脚疼得站不住了。
    “小白，你怎么样？”饭饭关心地问。
    “没事，我们走！”小白努力站了起来。
    “不用着急，休息一下吧。”
    “越早离开这儿越好，走！”
    太阳快出来了，但月亮还没有离开。高大的雪山上听不到一点儿声音，饭饭和小白在雪地上走着。小白的腿没有好，他们走得不快，但他们一点儿也不着急，因为希望就在前面。
fullText.traditional:
九、就是現在

    小白咬住大鵰的翅膀，向洞口走去。
    “放開我！”大鵰疼得大叫，他生氣極了，想要飛起來，但小白沒有給他機會。大鵰越來越疼，也越來越害怕。兩年前被小白咬住的那一次，他都沒有這麼害怕。
    小白大叫一聲，大鵰聽不清他叫了什麼，但是石頭後面的飯飯聽清了——“小貓！快！就是現在！”
    飯飯馬上跑出來，把手裡的石頭飛了出去！石頭打在了大鵰的頭和眼睛上！
    “啊！”大鵰疼得快哭了。他的翅膀和頭都有些紅色的東西，他知道那是什麼，但他的眼睛太疼了，他看不清。
    “誰……是誰打我？”
    “疼！太疼了！”
    “放開我……”
    “我的眼睛……怎麼……怎麼看不見了……”
    “小白……放開……我……”
    “……”
    大鵰的聲音越來越小，後來，他叫不出來了，也不動了。
    小白跑到洞外，努力爬上一塊大石頭。他站在高高的石頭上，放開了大鵰。
    大鵰的翅膀動了動，但他飛不起來了。他的身體像是一塊石頭，從山上直直地掉了下去。一聲，兩聲，三聲……小白和飯飯聽得到他的身體掉在下面石頭上的聲音。
    聽著這些聲音，小白坐到了地上，他的腿和腳疼得站不住了。
    “小白，你怎麼樣？”飯飯關心地問。
    “沒事，我們走！”小白努力站了起來。
    “不用著急，休息一下吧。”
    “越早離開這兒越好，走！”
    太陽快出來了，但月亮還沒有離開。高大的雪山上聽不到一點兒聲音，飯飯和小白在雪地上走著。小白的腿沒有好，他們走得不快，但他們一點兒也不著急，因為希望就在前面。

sentences.simplified: 小白咬住大雕的翅膀，向洞口走去。
sentences.traditional: 小白咬住大鵰的翅膀，向洞口走去。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái yǎo zhù dà diāo de chì bǎng xiàng dòng kǒu zǒu qù
sentences.english: Little Bai, biting the big eagle’s wing, walked toward the cave entrance.

sentences.simplified: “放开我！”大雕疼得大叫，他生气极了，
sentences.traditional: “放開我！”大鵰疼得大叫，他生氣極了，
sentences.pinyin: fàng kāi wǒ dà diāo téng de dà jiào tā shēng qì jí le
sentences.english: “Let go of me!” the big eagle cried out in pain. He was extremely angry.

sentences.simplified: 想要飞起来，但小白没有给他机会。
sentences.traditional: 想要飛起來，但小白沒有給他機會。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng yào fēi qǐ lái dàn xiǎo bái méi yǒu gěi tā jī huì
sentences.english: He wanted to fly away, but Little Bai didn’t give him a chance.

sentences.simplified: 大雕越来越疼，也越来越害怕。
sentences.traditional: 大鵰越來越疼，也越來越害怕。
sentences.pinyin: dà diāo yuè lái yuè téng yě yuè lái yuè hài pà
sentences.english: The big eagle was in more and more pain, and was getting more and more scared.

sentences.simplified: 两年前被小白咬住的那一次，他都没有这么害怕。
sentences.traditional: 兩年前被小白咬住的那一次，他都沒有這麼害怕。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng nián qián bèi xiǎo bái yǎo zhù de nà yí cì tā dōu méi yǒu zhè me hài pà
sentences.english: Even the time two years ago when Little Bai bit him, he wasn’t this scared.

sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái dà jiào yì shēng
sentences.english: Little Bai let out a loud cry.

sentences.simplified: 大雕听不清他叫了什么，但是石头后面的饭饭听清了——“小猫！快！就是现在！”
sentences.traditional: 大鵰聽不清他叫了什麼，但是石頭後面的飯飯聽清了——“小貓！快！就是現在！”
sentences.pinyin: dà diāo tīng bù qīng tā jiào le shén me dàn shì shí tou hòu miàn de fàn fàn tīng qīng le xiǎo māo kuài jiù shì xiàn zài
sentences.english: The big eagle couldn’t make out what he said, but Fanfan behind the rock heard it clearly—“Little cat! Quick! Now is the time!”

sentences.simplified: 饭饭马上跑出来，把手里的石头飞了出去！石头打在了大雕的头和眼睛上！
sentences.traditional: 飯飯馬上跑出來，把手裡的石頭飛了出去！石頭打在了大鵰的頭和眼睛上！
sentences.pinyin: fàn fàn mǎ shàng pǎo chu lai bǎ shǒu lǐ de shí tou fēi le chū qù shí tou dǎ zài le dà diāo de tóu hé yǎn jing shang
sentences.english: Fanfan immediately ran out and hurled the rock in his hand! The rock hit the big eagle’s head and eyes!

sentences.pinyin: a dà diāo téng de kuài kū le
sentences.english: “Ahh!” The big eagle was in so much pain that he was about to cry.

sentences.simplified: 他的翅膀和头都有些红色的东西，他知道那是什么，但他的眼睛太疼了，他看不清。
sentences.traditional: 他的翅膀和頭都有些紅色的東西，他知道那是什麼，但他的眼睛太疼了，他看不清。
sentences.pinyin: tā de chì bǎng hé tóu dōu yǒu xiē hóng sè de dōng xi tā zhī dào nà shì shén me dàn tā de yǎn jing tài téng le tā kàn bù qīng
sentences.english: There was some red stuff on his wing and head. He knew what it was, but his eyes hurt too much, and he couldn’t see clearly.

sentences.pinyin: shéi shì shéi dǎ wǒ
sentences.english: “Who … who hit me?”

sentences.pinyin: téng tài téng le
sentences.english: “It hurts! It hurts so much!”

sentences.pinyin: fàng kāi wǒ
sentences.english: “Let go of me …”

sentences.simplified: “我的眼睛……怎么……怎么看不见了……”
sentences.traditional: “我的眼睛……怎麼……怎麼看不見了……”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de yǎn jing zěn me zěn me kàn bú jiàn le
sentences.english: “My eyes … why… why can’t I see …”

sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái fàng kāi wǒ
sentences.english: “Little Bai … let go … of me …”

sentences.simplified: 大雕的声音越来越小，后来，他叫不出来了，也不动了。
sentences.traditional: 大鵰的聲音越來越小，後來，他叫不出來了，也不動了。
sentences.pinyin: dà diāo de shēng yīn yuè lái yuè xiǎo hòu lái tā jiào bù chu lai le yě bú dòng le
sentences.english: The big eagle’s voice grew weaker and weaker, and eventually, he couldn’t make a sound or move anymore.

sentences.simplified: 小白跑到洞外，努力爬上一块大石头。
sentences.traditional: 小白跑到洞外，努力爬上一塊大石頭。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái pǎo dào dòng wài nǔ lì pá shàng yí kuài dà shí tou
sentences.english: Little Bai ran outside the cave and struggled to climb onto a large rock.

sentences.simplified: 他站在高高的石头上，放开了大雕。
sentences.traditional: 他站在高高的石頭上，放開了大鵰。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhàn zài gāo gāo de shí tou shang fàng kāi le dà diāo
sentences.english: He stood on the high rock and let go of the big eagle.

sentences.simplified: 大雕的翅膀动了动，但他飞不起来了。
sentences.traditional: 大鵰的翅膀動了動，但他飛不起來了。
sentences.pinyin: dà diāo de chì bǎng dòng le dòng dàn tā fēi bù qǐ lái le
sentences.english: The big eagle’s wings moved slightly, but he could no longer fly.

sentences.simplified: 他的身体像是一块石头，从山上直直地掉了下去。
sentences.traditional: 他的身體像是一塊石頭，從山上直直地掉了下去。
sentences.pinyin: tā de shēn tǐ xiàng shì yí kuài shí tou cóng shān shang zhí zhí de diào le xià qù
sentences.english: His body was like a rock, falling straight down from the mountain.

sentences.simplified: 一声，两声，三声……小白和饭饭听得到他的身体掉在下面石头上的声音。
sentences.traditional: 一聲，兩聲，三聲……小白和飯飯聽得到他的身體掉在下面石頭上的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: yì shēng liǎng shēng sān shēng xiǎo bái hé fàn fàn tīng de dào tā de shēn tǐ diào zài xià miàn shí tou shang de shēng yīn
sentences.english: One thud, two thuds, three thuds … Little Bai and Fanfan could hear the sound of his body hitting the rocks below.

sentences.simplified: 听着这些声音，小白坐到了地上，他的腿和脚疼得站不住了。
sentences.traditional: 聽著這些聲音，小白坐到了地上，他的腿和腳疼得站不住了。
sentences.pinyin: tīng zhe zhè xiē shēng yīn xiǎo bái zuò dào le dì shang tā de tuǐ hé jiǎo téng de zhàn bú zhù le
sentences.english: Hearing these sounds, Little Bai sat down on the ground. His legs and feet were in too much pain to stand.

sentences.simplified: “小白，你怎么样？”饭饭关心地问。
sentences.traditional: “小白，你怎麼樣？”飯飯關心地問。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái nǐ zěn me yàng fàn fàn guān xīn de wèn
sentences.english: “Little Bai, how are you?” Fanfan asked with concern.

sentences.simplified: “没事，我们走！”小白努力站了起来。
sentences.traditional: “沒事，我們走！”小白努力站了起來。
sentences.pinyin: méi shì wǒ men zǒu xiǎo bái nǔ lì zhàn le qǐ lái
sentences.english: “It’s okay, let’s go!” Little Bai struggled to stand up.

sentences.pinyin: bú yòng zháo jí xiū xi yí xià ba
sentences.english: “No need to rush. We can rest for a while.”

sentences.pinyin: yuè zǎo lí kāi zhè‘r yuè hǎo zǒu
sentences.english: “The sooner we leave here, the better. Let’s go!”

sentences.simplified: 太阳快出来了，但月亮还没有离开。
sentences.traditional: 太陽快出來了，但月亮還沒有離開。
sentences.pinyin: tài yáng kuài chū lái le dàn yuè liang hái méi yǒu lí kāi
sentences.english: The sun was about to come up, but the moon was still in the sky.

sentences.simplified: 高大的雪山上听不到一点儿声音，饭饭和小白在雪地上走着。
sentences.traditional: 高大的雪山上聽不到一點兒聲音，飯飯和小白在雪地上走著。
sentences.pinyin: gāo dà de xuě shān shang tīng bú dào yì diǎn'r shēng yīn fàn fàn hé xiǎo bái zài xuě dì shang zǒu zhe
sentences.english: On the majestic, snowy mountain, not a sound could be heard. Fanfan and Little Bai walked on the snow-covered ground.

sentences.simplified: 小白的腿没有好，他们走得不快，
sentences.traditional: 小白的腿沒有好，他們走得不快，
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái de tuǐ méi yǒu hǎo tā men zǒu de bú kuài
sentences.english: Little Bai’s legs hadn’t healed, so they didn’t walk fast.

sentences.simplified: 但他们一点儿也不着急，因为希望就在前面。
sentences.traditional: 但他們一點兒也不著急，因為希望就在前面。
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā men yì diǎn'r yě bù zháo jí yīn wèi xī wàng jiù zài qián miàn
sentences.english: But they weren’t in a hurry at all, because hope was just ahead.

sentence_translations: (9) Now Is the Time
Little Bai, biting the big eagle’s wing, walked toward the cave entrance.
“Let go of me!” the big eagle cried out in pain. He was extremely angry.
He wanted to fly away, but Little Bai didn’t give him a chance.
The big eagle was in more and more pain, and was getting more and more scared.
Even the time two years ago when Little Bai bit him, he wasn’t this scared.
Little Bai let out a loud cry.
The big eagle couldn’t make out what he said, but Fanfan behind the rock heard it clearly—“Little cat! Quick! Now is the time!”
Fanfan immediately ran out and hurled the rock in his hand! The rock hit the big eagle’s head and eyes!
“Ahh!” The big eagle was in so much pain that he was about to cry.
There was some red stuff on his wing and head. He knew what it was, but his eyes hurt too much, and he couldn’t see clearly.
“Who … who hit me?”
“It hurts! It hurts so much!”
“Let go of me …”
“My eyes … why… why can’t I see …”
“Little Bai … let go … of me …”
The big eagle’s voice grew weaker and weaker, and eventually, he couldn’t make a sound or move anymore.
Little Bai ran outside the cave and struggled to climb onto a large rock.
He stood on the high rock and let go of the big eagle.
The big eagle’s wings moved slightly, but he could no longer fly.
His body was like a rock, falling straight down from the mountain.
One thud, two thuds, three thuds … Little Bai and Fanfan could hear the sound of his body hitting the rocks below.
Hearing these sounds, Little Bai sat down on the ground. His legs and feet were in too much pain to stand.
“Little Bai, how are you?” Fanfan asked with concern.
“It’s okay, let’s go!” Little Bai struggled to stand up.
“No need to rush. We can rest for a while.”
“The sooner we leave here, the better. Let’s go!”
The sun was about to come up, but the moon was still in the sky.
On the majestic, snowy mountain, not a sound could be heard. Fanfan and Little Bai walked on the snow-covered ground.
Little Bai’s legs hadn’t healed, so they didn’t walk fast.
But they weren’t in a hurry at all, because hope was just ahead.
